question: In the FINA World Swimming Championships (25m) 2022, which player set a national record in 100 m breaststroke?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Chahat Arora**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chahat Arora:-**

 
 
• Chahat Arora is an Indian swimmer who has represented India at various international swimming competitions.
 
• **She set a national record in 100m breaststroke at the FINA World Swimming Championships (25m) 2022.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **FINA World Swimming Championships (25m):-**

 
 
• It is a biennial swimming competition organized by FINA, the international governing body of aquatic sports.
 
 
 
• **Breaststroke:-**
 
 
• It is a swimming stroke in which the swimmer moves their arms in a circular motion while kicking their legs in a frog-like motion.
